jurisdictions.name: Unincorporated Santa Clara County
jurisdictions.notes: Department of Planning and Development (Building Inspection is part of it). plandev.santaclaracounty.gov returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch on 2026-09-30 (CDN bot protection, robots.txt also blocked), so page content was not read. building_dept_url (Permit Center page), adu_page_url (legacy plandev.sccgov.org domain) and parcel_lookup_url are exact County URLs from the search index (unverified, 403). Phone is the Department of Planning and Development main line, printed on its July 31, 2026 memo on the new Development Permit Application process; that memo is linked from the County's Public Permit Portal (permit_portal_url, read directly). It is a department line, not a Building Inspection-specific line. parcel_lookup_note: per the search-index excerpt (not read directly), the 'Find the jurisdiction' page tells residents to search an address or APN in the Department's Property Explorer to see whether a parcel is inside a city or in unincorporated County; Property Explorer replaced Property Profile and Interactive Property Assessment, and its info page is https://plandev.santaclaracounty.gov/access-property-information-property-explorer. The legacy Property Profile app http://profile.sccdpdapps.com/ timed out. The County open data portal's 'Unincorporated Areas' GIS layer (https://data.sccgov.org/Government/Unincorporated-Areas/vbcq-x9rd, 200) is a map layer, not an address lookup.
